description: Land Title Settlement Department - Watapuluwa West, Kandy Kadawath Hathara and Gangawata Koralaya D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320404
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the determination of land ownership and title settlements for specific parcels of land in Kandy District. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcels, their extents, owners, and encumbrances, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
